ITEM 1 | Wilted dark green leafy greens, glossy and slightly wet-looking, with thin orange carrot matchsticks scattered through and a few pale green stem pieces; forms a loose mound about 10 cm across on the left side of the plate, covering roughly a third of the plate surface, low-to-moderate height about 1.5 cm | 85
ITEM 2 | Cylindrical sliced pieces with dark reddish-brown smooth casing and a slightly glossy, firm surface, cut cross-sections showing a paler interior; about 6 rounds roughly 2.5 cm in diameter and 1.5 cm thick, stacked loosely in a cluster on the right side of the plate, about 5 cm across total, height about 2.5 cm | 70
